notes.title: Megamagic now for 8’99€ / 9’99$ / 7’99£!
notes.content:
[b]Since last Christmas holidays we’ve had an idea rounding our heads.[/b]

Since we are approaching the first year of life of our game “[b]Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age[/b]“, we thought it was necessary to facilitate the access to our game to every gamer out there who wanted to enjoy our [b]retro eighties action RPG[/b].

That’s why we’ve decided to make a [b]price drop[/b] on our game. You can now grab your copy of Megamagic at [url=store.steampowered.com/app/422650]Steam[/url] for just [b]8’99€ / 9’99$ / 7’99£[/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/19043373/5af163af8077eea3c548414ccdc06227a2a8beea.png[/img]

Also, stay tuned because very soon we’ll start unveiling details from our [b]new project[/b] and also we have [b]BIG NEWS[/b] for Megamagic… but you will have to wait. Don’t worry, [b]it will be worth the wait[/b].

Best,
- [b]BeautiFun Games Team[/b].

tags.balance_change: That’s why we’ve decided to make a [b]price drop[/b] on our game.

notes.title: Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age v1.05 released!
notes.content:
Hi all!
We're bringing you a new update for Megamagic, featuring:
- Windowed mode support (through avanced launcher, holding shift while launching the game).
- Re-balance for some hellish spawners, and some player grims!
- Bug fixing and several game improvements

Enjoy! ːfumː

notes.content:
v1.02 update notes:

- General game tweaking
- General bug fixing

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age v1.01
notes.content:
Hello!,

It's been two days since we released Megamagic, it was a crazy ride that we've enjoyed so far!. Now we hope you are enjoying our game too!.

Thanks to your feedback we will keep improving it, here are the release notes for the 1.01 version of Megamagic:

- Bug fixing on features and quests.
- Added on hover to in game spells & grims HUD.
- Improved the default resolution detection and not allowed aspect ratios.

Enjoy!

BeautiFun Games Team.
